passes.note: Reviewed runtime memory index implementation and smoke coverage. No blocker found: index remains non-authoritative, atomic writes validate before swap, active-only playbooks prevent candidate surfacing, and freshness/parity smokes pass.

Concept lane pass. The M0-M2 implementation is a derived runtime cache only: manifest authority is non_authoritative, gateEvidence is false, source digests are preserved, stale indexes fall back, and no lifecycle gate consumes the index as proof.

Test-coverage lane pass. Verified npm build plus index smoke, MVP1 smoke, MVP2 smoke, small baseline smoke, and health smoke. Coverage exercises atomic rebuild, malformed temp rejection, active-only playbooks, candidate exclusion, supersession suppression, and stale-relevant/stale-irrelevant behavior.

Docs lane pass. The optimization plan clearly separates full baseline validation from runtime entry paths, states memory remains advisory and gateEvidence false, and this story scope is M0-M2 rather than claiming all M0-M8 milestones complete.
